description: This bar chart, titled “Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models,” illustrates the effect sizes of four different model configurations—mBERT-targ, XLM-targ, mBERT-permute, and XLM-permute—across eight distinct language families or groups: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Semitic, and Uralic. The horizontal axis lists these language groups in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis, labeled “effect,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 40, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. Each language group is represented by a cluster of four bars, each corresponding to one model configuration as defined in the legend: mBERT-targ (light blue), XLM-targ (dark blue), mBERT-permute (light green), and XLM-permute (dark green). Error bars are present for each bar, indicating variability. The approximate values for the bars are as follows: for IE-Baltic, mBERT-targ is approximately 22, XLM-targ is approximately 15, mBERT-permute is approximately 6, and XLM-permute is approximately 5; for IE-Germanic, mBERT-targ is approximately 13, XLM-targ is approximately 12, mBERT-permute is approximately 9, and XLM-permute is approximately 9; for IE-Indic, mBERT-targ is approximately 5, XLM-targ is approximately 6, mBERT-permute is approximately 18, and XLM-permute is approximately 17; for IE-Romance, mBERT-targ is approximately 15, XLM-targ is approximately 12, mBERT-permute is approximately 3, and XLM-permute is approximately 3; for IE-Slavic, mBERT-targ is approximately 15, XLM-targ is approximately 11, mBERT-permute is approximately 9, and XLM-permute is approximately 9; for IE-other, mBERT-targ is approximately 15, XLM-targ is approximately 11, mBERT-permute is approximately 6, and XLM-permute is approximately 6; for Semitic, mBERT-targ is approximately 10, XLM-targ is approximately 10, mBERT-permute is approximately 9, and XLM-permute is approximately 9; for Uralic, mBERT-targ is approximately 29, XLM-targ is approximately 21, mBERT-permute is approximately 1, and XLM-permute is approximately 1. The bars are not sorted by height and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard presentation with error bars.
